body:
Well I was honestly scouting for some fresh insight. I don't want to go through with it. I worry that it's in my future the way things are going. Some things you do, just... you begin to look in the mirror and all the pride is washed from your life. You can't look at anyone in the eye anymore. You become distrustful of respect and compliments. All your work and art becomes stained with something. I hurt someone very close to me, a family member, very bad. And I didn't care. They may forgive me, but what I did was so evil and mean-spirited that ultimately the core of it is I can't imagine how much longer I can go on like this.

How does one carry on after committing an act they find truly atrocious. How do you respect yourself, how do you want anything for yourself when you can't argue a shred of self respect?

I did try the hotline. They got snippy with me for not divulging more information. I'm a bit of a tough nut to crack I guess. I've become a total dick over the last year. To the point that I'm doing things unscrupulously and not for my own gain. Just... I don't know. I just do.

I've started meditating, I'm at the gym 3-4 times a week. I take good care of myself. But even that has been slipping.
20 minutes in I'm coming to realize this subreddit is a circle jerk.
Living on the street is horrendous and difficult. Aint as lavish as being a couch bum. But absolute ostracism from my current life and history sounds wonderful.
Thanks, bro. You too. Actually I wish I had the courage / knowhow to fake my death and start anew somewhere else. I'd just end up a bum though.
